body:
Hello!

auto-merge is enabled in the repo, which is great.
But if you have a single nit to report, but want to give LGTM (so people in other timezones don't have to wait another day just for a nit), the auto-submit seems to kick in directy.
It seems that Github has an option: "Require conversation resolution before merging"

Shall this be enabled on the main branch?

comments.body: We'll need to have some conversations, but initially, I think this aligns with how we'd like to do things.
This has been done for all branches. If it looks to be more trouble than it's worth, we'll reconsider.

Hello!
Just approved https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/pull/7369#pullrequestreview-2786970317 with a comment, and the auto-merge merged the PR. Was the setting changed?

title: [Github] Enable "Require conversation resolution before merging" ?
